## Learning goal

I can show an idea clearly enough for another person to understand it and give useful feedback.

<img src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ/export/png?id=1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ&amp;pageid=p6" alt="Create and Communicate stage of the N.I.C.E. process." style="display:block;max-width:960px;width:100%;margin-inline:auto">

## Build enough to learn

Use a sketch, labelled drawing, storyboard, CAD model, mock-up, sample, process map, or partial prototype. Do not build the full product when a simpler model can answer the important question.

## Pitch in under one minute

1. **Situation:** Have you ever experienced ___?
2. **Need:** And needed or wanted ___?
3. **Idea:** Our idea is ___; it helps by ___.
4. **Show it:** point to the drawing, model, or demonstration.
5. **Ask:** request feedback about one specific decision.

Use the [Communicate Worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1T6f3beZhKXiOxS1ecXt3FHbam2yOqeP1yXrmaLFSbAs/edit), [Feedback Package](https://docs.google.com/document/d/173eivGi-7of6WWqpPsK81p4Z2Q6_3fIiW5ffjRI6jRQ/edit), and [Plan and Plan Feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QWY7ss3aY5wHh4ETOcSDGZxgpkrrIXcCYnWlXNv1lxo/edit).
